No front door

Followers who aren’t ready leave no trace

A man who finds your content but isn’t ready to apply for Reforged has nothing free to opt into. You can’t follow up with someone you never captured.

Courses unfed

Your courses wait to be found

They only sell when someone goes looking on your website. Nothing walks a new follower from a post to a course to an application.

No ads

Every application depends on today’s post

All your demand comes from organic reach. A quiet week of posting means fewer applications, and there’s no way to turn spend into booked calls.

Anyone not ready to apply for Reforged today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach him again.

Script 1

Script 1 · “Push through”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Most men were taught one move for everything: push through.”

Body

“It works. For a while. You get the job done, you hold everyone up. But nobody teaches you what to do when pushing through stops working. That’s what I want to talk about.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a free 60-minute class called Beyond Survival. Replay included. Tap Sign up to grab a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, tight framing, on-screen text “push through” with a strike-through. End card: “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2

Script 2 · “Strength vs armour”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s the difference between strength and armour.”

Body

“Armour keeps things out. It made sense once. Strength lets the right things in and still stands. A lot of men are carrying armour they don’t need any more, and calling it strength.”

CTA

“In my free masterclass, Beyond Survival, I’ll show you what to do about it. Live, 60 minutes. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple two-column slide: Armour / Strength. End card disclaimer.

Script 3

Script 3 · “Something left for home”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What if you came home with something left in the tank?”

Body

“So many men give everything at work and arrive home with nothing. Not because they don’t care. Because no one showed them another way. There are simple habits that change that, and they can be learned.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through them in my free class, Beyond Survival. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera in a calm, lived-in setting. End card disclaimer.
